tasks.title: Diff recovered working code vs ClipForge's current launch/session-restore/cache code; identify divergences plausibly causing the second-open crash
tasks.notes:
DONE (session-06, 2026-09-12): diff complete. The recovered WORKING app and the current app use the IDENTICAL launch state model — EncryptedSharedPreferences CredentialStore + CacheFirstStore JSON cache under filesDir — so the fix is to restore the working app's exact launch architecture into ClipForge. Three launch-relevant divergences found, all in paths that ONLY run when saved state exists (second open):
  (1) CACHE-FIRST DROPPED: working app's VM holds CacheFirstStore instances for tasks/series/music and renders INSTANTLY from the on-disk cache via onTasksOpen()->loadFromCache(), then background refresh(). Current app imports CacheFirstStore but never instantiates it — refreshAll() in init hits the NETWORK on every open and rebuilds state from scratch, the exact anti-pattern engine/ARCHITECTURE.md forbids.
  (2) UNGUARDED refreshAll() IN INIT: original v1 (08b9d63, the version the operator says crashed) called refreshAll() from init with NO try/catch. Recovered working app never calls refreshAll() in init at all — cache load is synchronous & safe, refresh is deferred to the UI (LaunchedEffect). Current code patched v1 forward by wrapping refreshAll() in try/catch, but a Kotlin `by lazy`/stateIn initializer or a rethrown exception inside a launch still escapes; the robust fix is the working architecture (no network in init).
  (3) security-crypto VERSION: working app shipped 1.1.0-alpha06 and ran stable; session-04/05 bumped to 1.1.0 'stable' while patching forward. Returning to the recovered-working launch path (lazy-guarded store, plain-prefs fallback already present) makes the keystore race unreachable.
ROOT-CAUSE MODEL: the crash is a second-open-only state-restoration failure on the launch path (MainActivity.onCreate -> VM init -> refreshAll network + no cache render). Fix = replace the current init/refresh launch behavior with the recovered working cache-first launch architecture, adapted to ClipForge's data (TaskStatus/MusicTrack/AppSettings already have toJson/fromJson). No new dependencies.

tasks.title: Implement fix — replace divergent ClipForge implementation with the recovered working approach (adapted to ClipForge data); add launch-restoration crash logging
tasks.notes: DONE (session-07, 2026-09-12): replaced ClipForge's divergent launch architecture with the recovered working one (apps/clipforge @ 65891f6), adapted to ClipForge's data. (1) taskStore/musicStore = CacheFirstStore<TaskStatus>/<MusicTrack> backed by filesDir/tasks.json + music.json — tasks, activeTasks, completedTasks, tasksRefreshing, music, musicRefreshing now flow from the stores; fetchTasksRemote() carries the former refreshTasks network body. (2) onTasksOpen()/onMusicOpen() = loadFromCache() (synchronous, network-free) + background refresh(); wired via LaunchedEffect(Unit) in TasksScreen, CompletedScreen, SeriesScreen, SeriesDetailScreen, MusicScreen. (3) init{} no longer calls refreshAll() — launch path is purely: guarded credential load -> _ready=true, exactly the working app's architecture; refreshAll() survives only as post-login action in connectExisting/createClone. (4) signOut() deletes the cache files and reloads empty state. (5) Added TaskStatus.toJson() (status.json shape) so the tasks cache can persist; MusicTrack.toJson already existed. (6) Retained from sessions 04/05: startup crash-catcher (last_crash.txt -> dialog on next launch) and guarded CredentialStore with plain-prefs fallback. No new dependencies; no engine/ change needed (CacheFirstStore was already copied into the app).

tasks.title: Validate — Kotlin structure check + code-level trace of cold-start vs saved-state-exists launch paths
tasks.notes: DONE (session-07, 2026-09-12): (1) Kotlin structure check (state-machine tokenizer, template/comment/char aware) — ALL 20 files balanced. (2) No stale references: grep for _tasks./_music. in the VM returns nothing; all UI call sites use onTasksOpen/onMusicOpen/refreshTasks/refreshMusic. (3) CODE TRACE cold-start vs saved-state open: FIRST OPEN (no state): CredentialStore.load() returns null -> login=null -> OnboardingScreen; no cache files -> loadFromCache() returns empty lists (file.exists() guard). SECOND OPEN (saved state): init reads ONLY SharedPreferences via the guarded prefs getter (absorbs failed encrypted lazy-init, plain fallback) — no network, no disk-cache parse, no throwing call; UI composes immediately; TasksScreen's LaunchedEffect then runs onTasksOpen() -> loadFromCache() wrapped in runCatching (malformed JSON -> empty list + Log.w, never throws) -> taskStore.refresh() which is fully exception-absorbing (runCatching around fetchRemote, mutex-serialized, keeps cache on failure). SettingsScreen/MusicScreen loads are likewise fully try/caught and run in viewModelScope AFTER composition. Conclusion by reading the code: no code path that runs only when saved state exists can throw before or during first composition. (4) Crash logging: the session-05 UncaughtExceptionHandler remains installed, so if this fix were incomplete the operator's next report carries the real stack trace.
